---
title: "Cholesterol and Mortality"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
# Using R

# Option 2: Read directly from GitHub

cholesterol_mortality <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-11-17/cholesterol_mortality.csv')

library(tidyverse)
library(mosaic)
library(car)
```

```{r}
deaths <- cholesterol_mortality %>%
  filter(died == 1)

favstats(deaths$total_chol)

high_low <- deaths %>%
  mutate(chol_type = case_when(total_chol > 200 ~ "High",
                               total_chol < 100 ~ "Low",
                               TRUE ~ "Normal")) %>%
  filter(chol_type != "Normal")
```

```{r}
ggplot(deaths, aes(x = cause_of_death, y = total_chol)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "steelblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 5),
    text = element_text(family = "serif"),
    axis.line = element_line()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Cholesterol Levels Are Similar For All Causes of Death",
    x = "Cause of Death",
    y = "Total Cholesterol"
  )
```

```{r}
library(pander)
chol_aov <- aov(deaths$total_chol~deaths$cause_of_death)
pander(summary(chol_aov))
```

```{r}
chol_tukey <- TukeyHSD(chol_aov)
pander(chol_tukey)
```



```{r}
ggplot(high_low, aes(x = cause_of_death, fill = chol_type)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 5),
    legend.position = "top",
    text = element_text(family = "serif"),
    axis.line = element_line()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "More People With High Cholesterol Across All Causes of Death",
    x = "Cause of Death",
    y = "Count of People",
    fill = "Cholesterol Type"
  )
```
